source_text: Κατὰ κυριακὴν δὲ κυρίου συναχθέντες κλάσατε ἄρτον καὶ εὐχαριστήσατε, προεξομολογησάμενοι τὰ παραπτώματα ὑμῶν, ὅπως καθαρὰ ἡ θυσία ὑμῶν ᾖ. πᾶς δὲ ἔχων τὴν ἀμφιβολίαν μετὰ τοῦ ἑταίρου αὐτοῦ μὴ συνελθέτω ὑμῖν, ἕως ὁ??ʼ διαλλαγῶσιν, ἵνα μὴ κοινωθῇ ἡ θυσία ὑμῶν. αὕτη γάρ ἐστιν ἡ ῥηθεῖσα ὑπὸ κυρίον: Ἐν παντὶ τόπῳ καὶ χρόνῳ προσφέρειν μοι θυσίαν καθαράν. ὅτι βασιλεὺς μέγας εἰμί, λέγει κύριος, καὶ τὸ ὄνομά μου θαυμαστὸν ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσι.
pass_a_gloss: On the Lord's day, having gathered, break bread and give thanks, having confessed beforehand your transgressions, so that your sacrifice may be pure. But let anyone having a dispute with his fellow not gather with you, until they are reconciled, so that your sacrifice may not be defiled. For this is what was spoken by the Lord: In every place and at every time, offer to me a pure sacrifice. For I am a great king, says the Lord, and my name is wonderful among the nations.

bible_refs.note: offer to me a pure sacrifice

pass_b_english: On the Lord's day, when you come together, break bread and give thanks after confessing your transgressions so that your sacrifice may be pure. If anyone has a dispute with a fellow believer, that person must not join you until they are reconciled, so that your sacrifice may not be defiled. For this is what the Lord said: 'In every place and at every time offer me a pure sacrifice, for I am a great king, says the Lord, and my name is wonderful among the nations' (Malachi 1:11).

anf_compare.notes: Drafted from source only; ANF not shown to drafter.

review.notes: The translation accurately reflects the Greek text. Pass B correctly identifies the implied scripture reference (Malachi 1:11) which is necessary for the 'Scripture' requirement as the Greek text contains the quotation but no citation.

greek/didache.xml: 'ἐν παντὶ τόπῳ καὶ χρόνῳ προσφέρειν μοι θυσίαν καθαράν' matches Pass B's 'offer me a pure sacrifice'; 'ἐν παντὶ τόπῳ καὶ χρόνῳ προσφέρειν μοι θυσίαν καθαράν' matches Pass B's 'offer me a pure sacrifice'; 'βασιλεὺς μέγας εἰμί' matches Pass B's 'I am a great king'; 'τὸ ὄνομά μου θαυμαστὸν ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσι' matches Pass B's 'my name is wonderful among the nations'; Pass B includes 'Malachi 1:11' as a citation for 'offer me a pure sacrifice', which matches the Greek wording
